assumptions.statement: SCPs, RCPs, session policies and permission boundaries that were not supplied are not modelled; Allow results may over-approximate.
With id-token: write, any step can request an OIDC token through the runner URL and bearer environment variables.
Whether a repository mints classic or immutable subjects is unknown from files, so both are evaluated.
An AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity session lasts at most the role max_session_duration (default 3600 s).
A rotation resource means periodic rotation; the next rotation time is unknown, so survival is reported as up to N days.
Whether a secret or parameter holds a credential, and of what kind, is inferred from resource type and name patterns.
